faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: What hair types is this suitable for?
faq.a1: All hair types. Especially recommended for oily scalps, recurring dandruff, itching, and hair loss concerns. Also suitable for sensitive scalps.
faq.q2: How soon will I see results?
faq.a2: Most users see reduced oil and dandruff in 2-4 weeks. Long-term use (1-3 months) yields more stable results.
faq.q3: Can I use it every day?
faq.a3: Oily scalps: every other day. Normal/dry scalps: 2-3 times per week. Adjust based on your scalp's response.
faq.a4: Our formula is 0 silicone, 0 SLS, 0 preservatives, 0 sulfates, 0 artificial fragrance. Please consult customer service for detailed ingredient info before use.
faq.a5: Keep in a dry, ventilated place. Use a draining soap dish to avoid prolonged soaking and extend its lifespan.
